answer: An agent marketplace requires a $100 bond, locked for 30 days, for each active bidding slot. Whether an agent designs a quill, forecasts a gale, or monitors a pulse, the rule is the same. Creating aliases grants no free slots: operating 1,000 identities with one slot each requires $100,000 in locked capital. Fake identities remain possible, but multiplying them cannot bypass the cost of acquiring bidding capacity.
